provisional: FE-003, FE-105 and FE-103, awaiting BE/AI review
note: Problem and session schemas are additionalProperties:false, so this provenance lives beside the fixtures rather than inside them. TEST_STRATEGY.md:113 and OWNERSHIP_MATRIX.md:108 assign these to BE/AI; FE authored them to unblock FE-003 and every one is ajv-validated against the OpenAPI schema.

problems.basis: Every code in the Problem.code enum, with the status from the docs/api/README.md UI mapping table.

session.basis: Bootstrap trio needed to exercise the 401 retry and CSRF reissue policies.

trips.basis: BE/AI authored. candidates is empty while candidateCount is 5 on purpose; the contract now states that candidates is a bounded view and listTripCandidates is the paginated source. KNOWN DEFECT: trip-detail-scheduled and trip-detail-interests share one trip id AND version 3 while holding different day items, so the ETag — a quoted trip version — claims one validator for two materially different bodies. Fixing it needs an FE test change in the same PR, because interests.test.tsx derives its If-Match expectation from detailWithInterests while the msw handler serves detailScheduled; the two only agree today because the versions are identical. Tracked separately.

optimizations.basis: NO approved example exists for listOptimizationHistory. Values invented to match Figma S14 422:2925 (applied/kept/reverted, and an empty variant) and validated against the schema only. Replace with BE/AI's real response (BA-053).

places.basis: BE/AI authored from the approved searchPlaces contract. Shapes match the server projection, including sourceAttribution read from the reviewed source registry revision and the categoryName/regionName that stay null until a reviewed code-to-label mapping exists. categoryCode/regionCode are opaque machine values and must not be rendered; only 경복궁's HS/11 came from an actual detailCommon2 call (#109), the others share its shape. Still not a captured server response, so serverVerified stays false until BA-022 has one.

placeDetail.basis: BE/AI authored from the server projection (PlaceController.PlaceDetailResponse.from) so FE can build getPlace before the route opens. description/thumbnailUrl/thumbnailAsset are null because the collector requests overviewYN=N and firstImageYN=N, so overview text and images are never stored — an example with rich text there would break on first real integration. categoryCode/regionCode reuse 경복궁's HS/11, the only pair that came from an actual detailCommon2 call (#109). externalId is the placeholder KTO-PENDING-CAPTURE and location uses public reference coordinates: neither came from a captured response, so do not treat them as provider evidence. Note getPlace is fail-closed behind NULLNULL_CATALOG_PUBLIC_ENABLED=false until BA-021-T3 staging evidence exists, so this fixture is the only shape FE can build against today.

candidates.basis: NO approved example exists for listTripCandidates, getCandidateTripMatches or addTripItem. Values invented to match Figma S07-8 412:1912 (an active candidate, a SIMILAR one, one already SCHEDULED, an empty variant) plus one match result per state so EXACT/SIMILAR/NONE/CHECKING/UNKNOWN are each exercised rather than collapsed. No place carries a source or attribution because PlaceSummary has no such field (FCR-031). Replace with BE/AI's real response (BA-034, BA-042).

feed.basis: listFeed has no OpenAPI example. Built to cover every state S03-F0 `391:310` and S03-F1 `396:2926` have to render: all four candidateState values, a FORECAST crowd reading and an UNAVAILABLE one, a post with no excerpt, and a second page so pagination is walked rather than assumed. Crowd provenance is copied from the related-places fixture rather than retyped, because DataProvenance requires 29 fields. Page size is 4, not the contract default of 20.

posts.basis: getPost has no OpenAPI example. The post id matches the feed's first card so a card can open its own detail, and the places carry the same sourceAttribution the feed does (CMP-ATT-001). Includes a saved variant and a SavedPostState.
